From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@aws-partner.com>

Subject: Marketplace MAP: Acme Retail — kickoff & timeline

Priya / Acme team —

Thanks for the time last week. This thread is to kick off a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) to align the marketplace listing + evaluation plan so we can shorten your internal procurement window and close on reserved capacity. Attaching a draft MAP and an evaluation checklist to get the conversation going.

High-level goals:
- Target: production pilot with Redwood Dedicated + AWS Marketplace listing by end of Q3.
- Evaluation scope: performance baseline, security/compliance review, contract & procurement, pricing and AWS listing ops.

Proposed owners (initial):
- Acme: Priya Sharma (buyer/POC), Platform Eng: TBD, Security: Anita Rao (sec)
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (AE, sales lead), Marissa Cole (Partner Ops), Jasmine Liu (Solutions/tech lead)
- AWS Marketplace: Aaron Lee (partner ops)

Suggested near-term timeline (draft):
- Week 1 (this week): stakeholder alignment, share MAP and SOC2 evidence, confirm procurement milestones
- Week 2: evaluation ramp — test harness, baseline perf run, pricing worksheet review
- Week 3–4: finalize contract terms, prepare listing artifacts with AWS, schedule go/no-go

Please review the attached MAP (Acme_MAP_v0.2.pdf) and the evaluation checklist (Acme_Eval_Checklist.xlsx). Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to confirm owners and pick a firm target date? I can do: Tue 7/21 10–11am PT, Wed 7/22 9–10am PT, Thu 7/23 3–4pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_v0.2.pdf] [Attachment: Acme_Eval_Checklist.xlsx]

Of your proposed slots, Wed 7/22 9–9:30am PT or Thu 7/23 3–3:30pm PT work best for me. If you can hold the 30-min slot, we can get everyone aligned quickly.
